opening.argument: The session is plainly instructional and product-focused: it teaches viewers about Slack apps, including “three types of apps that serve very different use cases for the people in your organization,” and explains how to bring those tools into Slack to organize a workforce. The presentation also shows concrete operational demonstrations, including a slide listing External Apps, Workflow Apps, and Custom Apps and a Workflow Builder interface with trigger options. Its focus is on integrating and automating applications to address business problems, while the described links serve ordinary audience or product engagement rather than imposing conditions for a financial offer.

citations.quote: At Slack, there are three types of apps that serve very different use cases for the people in your organization.
how we can use and bring these tools and apps into Slack to help you organize yourself and your workforce
